In conclusion, while putting hair in the trash is a responsible choice to prevent clogs, exploring more sustainable disposal methods is encouraged if available.

In terms of environmental impact, throwing hair in the trash contributes to landfill waste. If there's a way to compost it or use it elsewhere, that would be more eco-friendly. If the bathroom doesn't have one, maybe installing a drain screen would help prevent future clogs and make maintenance easier.
